correctness.rationale: For intrinsic graph Čech nerve N(Q5,3), the published facet lemma gives exactly 80 ten-vertex simplices N1[u]∪N1[v]. Independently constructed all 54,416 nonempty faces and exactly f=(32,400,2560,8320,14592,14752,9280,3600,800,80). Fresh sparse mod-two boundary rank reduction of the full chain complex yielded H3 dimension9 and H4 dimension120 and zero other reduced homology over F2, hence rational H3<=9, H4<=120; Euler characteristic and fixed-face signed Lefschetz computation for all 32 translations gives by Hamming weight (111,31,-17,-9,-1,-1). Rational Walsh inversion yields virtual H4-H3 character multiplicities by subset weight (0,6,6,3,-1,-4). The negative multiplicities force at least 9 H3 dimensions and therefore saturate the F2 upper bound, giving H3 weight4:1 and weight5:4 and H4 weight1:6 weight2:6 weight3:3. This is a complete finite proof of rational characters; integral torsionlessness is not required for the claim. No trivial character occurs, so quotient rationally acyclic.
